biosurvey_implementation.adapter_contract: native region + environmental SpatRaster; never ACSP finite candidate frame

objective: focal-taxon held-out regional recovery under a maximum five-site field budget

cohort_and_outcomes.cohort: the exact frozen 192 taxon-region pairs used by the Practical Core primary confirmation
cohort_and_outcomes.outer_folds: the exact five frozen primary holdout folds per pair; biosurvey designs are frozen before the held_out_occurrences.csv file is opened

common_environment.source: same Japan GSI terrain information family used by ACSP local candidate generation
common_environment.aspect_transform: sin/cos derived from the same aspect values before PCA
common_environment.region: the exact fixed cohort region rectangle; no occurrence-conditioned mask
common_environment.grid_rule: regular lon/lat grid covering the region; extract the same GSI terrain information at cell centers; cells with incomplete terrain are removed without outcome-dependent replacement
common_environment.reason_for_two_resolutions: predeclare a moderate resolution sensitivity rather than choose one raster discretization after outcomes

uniformE.environment: PC1/PC2 from centered and scaled PCA of the six common terrain layers

EG.n_blocks_rule: evaluate native n_blocks=1..5 without outcomes and retain the native design with the largest selected-site count <=5; ties choose larger n_blocks; never truncate

stochastic_design.reuse_rule: because biosurvey is taxon-independent under this native contract, the same pre-outcome region/resolution/seed design library is reused for every declared taxon and fold in that region
stochastic_design.fold_estimand: mean held-out recovery over the 10 frozen designs for a biosurvey method/resolution configuration

comparison.unit: taxon-region pair after averaging five frozen outer folds
comparison.configuration_pass_rule: Practical Core minus configuration mean difference >=0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% lower >0 AND pair sign-flip p<0.05 AND 12-region cluster-bootstrap 95% lower >0 on all 192 declared pairs
comparison.biosurvey_family_pass_rule: all six predeclared method-resolution configurations pass
comparison.claim_if_passed: For this focal-taxon regional recovery objective and five-site budget, Practical Core outperformed all predeclared native biosurvey configurations across the two frozen terrain-grid resolutions
comparison.claim_if_failed: report every configuration; do not claim general superiority over biosurvey or existing survey-planning tools

relationship_to_grts_claim: broad existing-tool superiority requires both the separately frozen GRTS-family guardrail and this biosurvey-family gate to pass
